title: Response to the comment on “Enamel matrix derivative in the prevention and treatment of medication-related osteonecrosis of the jaws in rats”
html: We sincerely thank the authors for their interest and constructive comments regarding our recently published article, “Enamel matrix derivative in the prevention and treatment of medication-related osteonecrosis of the jaws in rats”1. We appreciate their recognition of our study design and findings, which contribute to understanding the regenerative potential of enamel matrix derivative (EMD) in the context of medication-related osteonecrosis of the jaws (MRONJ). Their thoughtful observations provide an opportunity to clarify our methodological framework further and highlight directions for future research.
